pages.title: It Is Supposed To Do That
pages.text: Some of what happens here reads like a broken game. It is not.$(br2)$(li)Whispering and voices in certain forests$(br)$(li)Knocking on doors at night$(br)$(li)A figure at the treeline that is gone when you look again$(br)$(li)Someone wearing a face you recognise

pages.title: The Stalkers
pages.text: A handful of things in this world hunt $(o)you$() specifically, on their own schedule, and the surface rules do not hold them back.$(br2)They are rare on purpose. If one has decided about you, you will know.$(br2)$(italic)Not everything that walks like a player is one.$()
